notes: Complete playable Linux x86-64 terminal dungeon (Rusty Dungeon) written in Rust with inline assembly; no_std / no Rust standard library / no C runtime. MIT at the repo-root LICENSE (Copyright 2025 Hayden Donnelly; git blob c6a53d427920eaa1507e53f0ede154142457c84e). Snapshot is the default-branch tip. Gameplay source is a single main.rs (md5 c752103ae94ec882e800b2508ff0cd01, 746 lines) plus flake.nix / flake.lock for a Nix rustc 1.89.0-nightly dev shell, README, and .gitignore. ASCII roguelike: arrow keys move, space dismisses messages, Q quits; player must find a key. No bundled TTF/OTF, no images/audio, no EXE/DLL, no Git LFS, no third-party game assets. flake.nix sets nixpkgs allowUnfree in the dev shell but does not add any unfree packages (buildInputs are only the fenix rustc/cargo toolchain). Compile with: rustc -C panic=abort -C link-arg=-nostartfiles main.rs; run ./main on x86-64 Linux. ~28K src snapshot. Claim #4160.
